## Method of Procedure, Test and Handover Templates

<!-- SOURCE-BLOCK IT:1 END -->

<!-- SOURCE-BLOCK IT:2 BEGIN -->

*Copy a clean record for each controlled change or test.*

<!-- SOURCE-BLOCK IT:2 END -->

<!-- SOURCE-BLOCK IT:3 BEGIN -->

Kit v1.0 • 16 September 2026 • Aligned to the frozen v1.4 reference architecture

<!-- SOURCE-BLOCK IT:3 END -->

<!-- SOURCE-BLOCK IT:4 BEGIN -->

Working kit, not an approved site design or deployed platform. Templates, reference examples and live evidence are separate records.

<!-- SOURCE-BLOCK IT:4 END -->

<!-- SOURCE-BLOCK IT:5 BEGIN -->

The teal fields are editable Word content controls. Use a project-controlled copy, give every execution a stable ID, and retain the final record alongside protected evidence. Add rows or continuation pages as needed; no response field contains a supplied approval.
